title: Rolling updates and rollback: maxSurge, maxUnavailable and history

videos.script: Every time you changed the shop's image in this course, a Deployment replaced its pods. It did that while the shop kept answering, and you never had to say how. {{replace}} Two numbers decide how: how many extra pods may exist during the change, and how many may be missing. {{numbers}} You will count three hundred real requests during an update and see how many failed. Then you will ship a version that crashes, watch the rollout stop on its own, and go back with one command. {{plan}}
